description:
Sit/stand desk control for the IKEA IDASEN, with presets, an hourly stand schedule and a CLI.

Perch drives an IKEA IDASEN (Linak) sit/stand desk from Windows over Bluetooth LE.
Type an exact height in centimetres and press Go, save two presets, or run a schedule
that stands the desk up for a few minutes every hour between the times you choose.
It sits in the notification area so the schedule keeps working, and can start with
Windows.

The package also installs perch-cli, a command line tool for scripts and automation:
list devices, read the height, and move the desk, with JSON output and documented
exit codes.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Inter IKEA Systems B.V.
What's Changed
- Run on macOS as well as Windows, with perch-cli on both by @amir-khatibzadeh in #3
